title: Airport Access Fees and Toll Facilities Passed Through on Wayfare Rides
content:
Airport access fees and tolls on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** are passed through to the rider at the amounts below. The schedule is the same on all seven ride options — Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green, Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare XL, Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV.

## Airport access fees

The airport access fee is passed through to the rider per qualifying airport trip, by airport code; each airport charges its fee only on the trip ends listed for it.

| Airport | Access fee | Trip ends that carry the fee |
|---|---|---|
| DEN | $5.00 | pickup and drop-off |
| COS | $3.25 | pickup only |
| SLC | $4.25 | pickup and drop-off |
| PHX | $4.66 | pickup and drop-off |
| TUS | $3.00 | pickup only |
| LAS | $3.95 | pickup only |
| ABQ | $3.00 | pickup only |

## Toll facilities

The toll is passed through to the rider per crossing of each toll facility, by facility. Tolls are charged only for facilities actually crossed between pickup and drop-off (one charge per facility per trip).

| Toll facility | Toll |
|---|---|
| E-470 | $6.85 |
| Northwest Parkway | $4.30 |
| I-25 Express Lanes | $2.95 |
| US 36 Express Lanes | $2.60 |
| C-470 Express Lanes | $2.10 |
| Utah I-15 Express Lanes | $1.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- A drop-off at COS, TUS, LAS or ABQ is not a trip end on which those airports charge; a drop-off at DEN, SLC or PHX is.
- Hypothetical example: a trip picked up at SLC that crossed no toll facility carries $4.25 in airport access fee and no toll.
